description.en: IVF costs $12,000 to $25,000 per cycle in North Dakota in 2026. No state mandate. Sanford Fargo self-pay rates, Good Faith Estimate steps, and cash-pay tips.

h1.en: How Much Does IVF Cost in North Dakota in 2026?
h1.es: Cuanto Cuesta la FIV en Dakota del Norte en 2026?

subhero.en: A single IVF cycle in North Dakota costs $12,000 to $25,000 out of pocket in 2026, depending on the clinic, protocol, and add-ons. North Dakota has no state law requiring commercial insurance plans to cover IVF. House Bills 1282 and 1284, which would have expanded fertility coverage for public employees and commercial plans, were both defeated by the North Dakota House in February 2025. That means most North Dakota residents pay the full cost of IVF themselves, with no state mandate backstop and no North Dakota Medicaid coverage for the procedure. Fertility medications, genetic testing, and frozen embryo transfers are billed separately on top of the base cycle fee.
subhero.es: Un solo ciclo de FIV en Dakota del Norte cuesta de $12,000 a $25,000 de bolsillo en 2026, dependiendo de la clinica, el protocolo y los complementos. Dakota del Norte no tiene ley estatal que exija que los planes de seguro comercial cubran la FIV. Las Facturas de la Camara 1282 y 1284, que habrian ampliado la cobertura de fertilidad para empleados publicos y planes comerciales, fueron rechazadas por la Camara de Dakota del Norte en febrero de 2025. Eso significa que la mayoria de los residentes de Dakota del Norte pagan el costo total de la FIV por su cuenta, sin respaldo de mandato estatal y sin cobertura de Medicaid de Dakota del Norte para el procedimiento.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, a standard IVF cycle in North Dakota costs $12,000 to $17,000 for the base procedure at hospital-affiliated clinics such as Sanford Reproductive Medicine in Fargo, plus $2,000 to $7,000 in fertility medications, for a realistic all-in total of $15,000 to $25,000 per cycle. North Dakota has no state insurance mandate requiring coverage of IVF. North Dakota Medicaid does not cover IVF. Medicare does not cover IVF under any Part. Self-pay patients in North Dakota have the right to a written Good Faith Estimate before treatment begins under the No Surprises Act, effective January 1, 2022.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, un ciclo estandar de FIV en Dakota del Norte cuesta de $12,000 a $17,000 por el procedimiento base en clinicas afiliadas a hospitales como Sanford Reproductive Medicine en Fargo, mas $2,000 a $7,000 en medicamentos de fertilidad, para un total realista de $15,000 a $25,000 por ciclo. Dakota del Norte no tiene mandato de seguro estatal que exija cobertura de FIV. El Medicaid de Dakota del Norte no cubre la FIV. Medicare no cubre la FIV bajo ninguna Parte. Los pacientes que pagan de su bolsillo en Dakota del Norte tienen derecho a un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito antes de comenzar el tratamiento bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2022.

introParagraphs.en: North Dakota is one of the states with no insurance mandate for IVF coverage as of 2026. Two bills introduced during the 2025 legislative session, House Bill 1282 and House Bill 1284, attempted to expand fertility coverage for state employees through the Public Employees Retirement System (PERS) and for commercial plan members, but both were defeated in the North Dakota House (HB 1282 failed 36 to 51; HB 1284 failed 39 to 48) in February 2025, according to the Bismarck Tribune. Unlike Minnesota, which enacted the Building Families Act effective January 1, 2026, North Dakota residents who need IVF have no state law requiring their insurer to cover the procedure. Some employer plans voluntarily include fertility benefits, but coverage is not guaranteed and patients should check their Summary Plan Description before assuming their plan applies. Residents who are uninsured or self-pay should also check whether they qualify for North Dakota Medicaid through [hhs.nd.gov](https://www.hhs.nd.gov/healthcare/medicaid), though Medicaid does not cover IVF.
introParagraphs.es: Dakota del Norte es uno de los estados sin mandato de seguro para la cobertura de FIV a partir de 2026. Dos proyectos de ley introducidos durante la sesion legislativa de 2025, las Facturas de la Camara 1282 y 1284, intentaron ampliar la cobertura de fertilidad para empleados estatales a traves del Sistema de Jubilacion de Empleados Publicos (PERS) y para miembros de planes comerciales, pero ambos fueron derrotados en la Camara de Dakota del Norte en febrero de 2025. A diferencia de Minnesota, que promulgo la Ley de Familias Unidas vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2026, los residentes de Dakota del Norte que necesitan FIV no tienen una ley estatal que exija que su aseguradora cubra el procedimiento. Algunos planes de empleadores incluyen voluntariamente beneficios de fertilidad, pero la cobertura no esta garantizada.

introParagraphs.en: Sanford Reproductive Medicine in Fargo is the primary hospital-affiliated fertility clinic in North Dakota. Sanford partners with ARC Fertility to offer multi-cycle package pricing and financing options for patients without insurance coverage. Sanford's all-in IVF cycle cost (including egg retrieval, fertilization, monitoring, and one embryo transfer, with medications) is reported by patients at approximately $20,000 to $21,000, with frozen embryo transfer (FET) cycles at approximately $4,500 to $7,000 per transfer. Essentia Health in West Fargo offers infertility evaluations and intrauterine insemination (IUI), but patients requiring IVF are typically referred to Sanford or clinics in neighboring Minnesota. Some North Dakota patients also travel to CNY Fertility in Syracuse, New York, which publishes substantially lower national self-pay rates. The 2026 pricing data in this guide reflects North Dakota-area clinic rates sourced from patient-reported costs, RESOLVE national benchmarks, and KFF analysis of fertility service costs.
introParagraphs.es: Sanford Reproductive Medicine en Fargo es la principal clinica de fertilidad afiliada a hospital en Dakota del Norte. Sanford se asocia con ARC Fertility para ofrecer precios de paquetes de multiples ciclos y opciones de financiamiento para pacientes sin cobertura de seguro. El costo total del ciclo de FIV de Sanford (incluyendo recuperacion de ovulos, fertilizacion, monitoreo y una transferencia de embriones, con medicamentos) es reportado por pacientes en aproximadamente $20,000 a $21,000, con ciclos de transferencia de embriones congelados (TEC) de aproximadamente $4,500 a $7,000 por transferencia. Essentia Health en West Fargo ofrece evaluaciones de infertilidad e inseminacion intrauterina (IIU), pero los pacientes que requieren FIV generalmente son referidos a Sanford o clinicas en Minnesota.

introParagraphs.en: This guide covers what IVF costs in North Dakota in 2026, what North Dakota Medicaid and Medicare do and do not cover, the insurance landscape without a state mandate, and how to request a Good Faith Estimate from a North Dakota fertility clinic before starting treatment. The No Surprises Act, effective January 1, 2022, requires every fertility clinic and hospital to provide a written estimate of expected charges to self-pay and uninsured patients. Patients should also review [the No Surprises Act consumer guide](/en/no-surprises-act) and the federal patient-provider dispute resolution process at cms.gov/nosurprisesact for billing disputes. For patients who believe they may qualify for low-income coverage, North Dakota Medicaid eligibility is explained at hhs.nd.gov, and the federal [Medicaid income limits](/en/medicaid-income-limits) page can help determine whether state coverage is available for diagnostic services.
introParagraphs.es: Esta guia cubre lo que cuesta la FIV en Dakota del Norte en 2026, lo que el Medicaid de Dakota del Norte y Medicare cubren y no cubren, el panorama del seguro sin un mandato estatal, y como solicitar un Estimado de Buena Fe de una clinica de fertilidad de Dakota del Norte antes de comenzar el tratamiento. La Ley de No Sorpresas, vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2022, exige que cada clinica de fertilidad y hospital proporcione un estimado escrito de los cargos esperados a los pacientes que pagan de su bolsillo o no tienen seguro.

explanationParagraphs.en: North Dakota IVF pricing in 2026 is shaped primarily by the limited number of fertility clinics in the state. The 2026 site-of-service chart above shows that Sanford Reproductive Medicine, the primary hospital-affiliated provider in Fargo, bills at a premium reflecting full hospital overhead, staffing, and an integrated care model. Patient-reported costs for a complete fresh IVF cycle at Sanford including medications run approximately $20,000 to $21,000. Patients seeking lower self-pay costs sometimes travel to independent fertility clinics in the Minneapolis-Saint Paul metro area or to national lower-cost providers such as CNY Fertility. The clinical procedure, egg retrieval, fertilization, embryo culture, and embryo transfer, is identical between settings. The cost differential reflects overhead structure, lab infrastructure, and the presence or absence of a hospital facility fee, not a difference in clinical outcomes for most patients.
explanationParagraphs.es: Los precios de FIV en Dakota del Norte en 2026 estan determinados principalmente por el numero limitado de clinicas de fertilidad en el estado. La tabla de sitios de servicio 2026 anterior muestra que Sanford Reproductive Medicine, el principal proveedor afiliado a hospital en Fargo, factura a una tarifa que refleja los gastos generales totales del hospital. Los costos reportados por pacientes para un ciclo de FIV fresco completo en Sanford, incluyendo medicamentos, son de aproximadamente $20,000 a $21,000. Los pacientes que buscan costos mas bajos a veces viajan a clinicas de fertilidad independientes en el area metropolitana de Minneapolis-Saint Paul o a proveedores nacionales de menor costo como CNY Fertility.

explanationParagraphs.en: The listed North Dakota price ranges are for the base cycle procedure only, and the all-in cost is higher once medications, monitoring visits, anesthesia, and optional add-ons are included. Fertility medications billed separately typically add $2,000 to $7,000 per cycle depending on the stimulation protocol and the patient's ovarian response. Optional components, including preimplantation genetic testing (PGT), intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI), embryo cryopreservation, and annual embryo storage, are itemized separately by North Dakota clinics. Because North Dakota has no state insurance mandate as of 2026, self-pay patients should ask for a fully itemized Good Faith Estimate that breaks out every billable component before scheduling any part of the treatment cycle. Sanford's ARC Fertility partnership provides financing and multi-cycle package access for patients who do not have commercial insurance coverage.
explanationParagraphs.es: Los rangos de precios de Dakota del Norte listados son solo para el procedimiento del ciclo base, y el costo total es mayor una vez que se incluyen medicamentos, visitas de monitoreo, anestesia y complementos opcionales. Los medicamentos de fertilidad facturados por separado tipicamente agregan $2,000 a $7,000 por ciclo. Debido a que Dakota del Norte no tiene mandato de seguro estatal a partir de 2026, los pacientes que pagan de su bolsillo deben solicitar un Estimado de Buena Fe completamente detallado que desglosa cada componente facturable antes de programar cualquier parte del ciclo de tratamiento.

explanationParagraphs.en: Frozen embryo transfer (FET) cycles cost substantially less than fresh full cycles because the egg retrieval and fertilization steps were completed in a prior cycle. North Dakota FET rates in 2026 run $4,500 to $7,000 at Sanford, consistent with patient-reported costs from FertilityIQ reviews. Mini IVF, which uses lower hormone stimulation doses, reduces the medication cost significantly and is suitable for patients with diminished ovarian reserve or who prefer less intensive hormonal intervention. Mini IVF produces fewer eggs per cycle but brings the all-in total to approximately $6,000 to $11,000. For some North Dakota patients, traveling to a lower-cost clinic in Minnesota or elsewhere may save $5,000 to $10,000 per cycle while receiving clinically equivalent care.
explanationParagraphs.es: Los ciclos de transferencia de embriones congelados (TEC) cuestan sustancialmente menos que los ciclos frescos completos porque los pasos de recuperacion de ovulos y fertilizacion se completaron en un ciclo anterior. Las tarifas de TEC en Dakota del Norte en 2026 son de $4,500 a $7,000 en Sanford. La mini FIV usa dosis de estimulacion hormonal mas bajas, reduce significativamente el costo de los medicamentos y es adecuada para pacientes con reserva ovarica disminuida. Para algunos pacientes de Dakota del Norte, viajar a una clinica de menor costo en Minnesota u otros estados puede ahorrar de $5,000 a $10,000 por ciclo.

paragraphs.en: Medicare does not cover IVF under any part of the program, including Original Medicare Part A (hospital), Medicare Part B (outpatient), or Part D (prescription drugs). This is a federal program-level exclusion that applies in every state, including North Dakota. The 2026 Medicare Part B deductible of $283 and the standard 20% coinsurance apply only to services Medicare actually covers; because IVF is excluded, no Medicare deductible or coinsurance calculation applies to IVF costs. Medicare Advantage plans are not required to include IVF as a supplemental benefit, though a small number of Medicare Advantage plans voluntarily offer limited fertility-related extras. Patients on Medicare should check their specific plan's Summary of Benefits. Medigap supplemental plans also do not cover IVF because they only supplement services that Original Medicare covers.
paragraphs.es: Medicare no cubre la FIV bajo ninguna parte del programa, incluyendo el Medicare Original Parte A (hospital), Medicare Parte B (ambulatorio) o Parte D (medicamentos recetados). Esta es una exclusion a nivel de programa federal que aplica en todos los estados, incluyendo Dakota del Norte. El deducible de Medicare Parte B 2026 de $283 y el coseguro estandar del 20% solo aplican a los servicios que Medicare realmente cubre; como la FIV esta excluida, no aplica ningun calculo de deducible o coseguro de Medicare para los costos de FIV. Los planes Medicare Advantage no estan obligados a incluir la FIV como beneficio suplementario. Los planes suplementarios Medigap tampoco cubren la FIV porque solo complementan los servicios que cubre el Medicare Original.

paragraphs.en: North Dakota Medicaid, administered by the North Dakota Department of Health and Human Services, does not cover IVF as of mid-2026. North Dakota expanded Medicaid under the ACA, covering adults with household incomes up to 138% of the federal poverty level (approximately $21,597 for a single adult in 2026), but the Medicaid expansion did not extend to fertility treatment. Infertility diagnostic testing such as bloodwork, hormone panels, and pelvic ultrasounds may be covered by North Dakota Medicaid as clinically indicated diagnostic services, but the IVF procedure itself, including egg retrieval, fertilization, embryo transfer, and related laboratory services, is excluded. ACA-compliant plans sold through the federal marketplace at healthcare.gov are not required by federal law to cover IVF, though employers and plans may voluntarily include fertility benefits. If your employer's plan includes fertility coverage, review your Summary Plan Description to determine whether IVF specifically is included and whether your North Dakota clinic is in-network.
paragraphs.es: El Medicaid de Dakota del Norte, administrado por el Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos de Dakota del Norte, no cubre la FIV a mediados de 2026. Dakota del Norte expandio Medicaid bajo la ACA, cubriendo adultos con ingresos familiares de hasta el 138% del nivel de pobreza federal, pero la expansion de Medicaid no se extendio al tratamiento de fertilidad. Las pruebas diagnosticas de infertilidad como analisis de sangre, paneles hormonales y ecografias pelvicas pueden estar cubiertas por el Medicaid de Dakota del Norte como servicios diagnosticos clinicamente indicados, pero el procedimiento de FIV en si esta excluido. Los planes ACA-compliant vendidos a traves del mercado federal en healthcare.gov no estan obligados por ley federal a cubrir la FIV.

paragraphs.en: Under the No Surprises Act, effective January 1, 2022, any North Dakota patient paying cash or who is uninsured has the right to a written Good Faith Estimate from the fertility clinic or hospital before the IVF procedure begins. For a North Dakota IVF treatment cycle scheduled at least 10 business days out, the provider must furnish the Good Faith Estimate at least 3 business days before service. For appointments scheduled 3 to 9 business days out, the estimate arrives at least 1 business day before service. The federal consumer guidance and the patient-provider dispute resolution portal are available at cms.gov/nosurprisesact. A Good Faith Estimate for IVF in North Dakota must itemize the base cycle fee, anesthesia, monitoring visits, laboratory fees, medications if dispensed by the clinic, and any optional add-ons the patient has agreed to.
paragraphs.es: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2022, cualquier paciente de Dakota del Norte que paga en efectivo o no tiene seguro tiene derecho a un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito de la clinica de fertilidad u hospital antes de que comience el procedimiento de FIV. Para un ciclo de tratamiento de FIV en Dakota del Norte programado al menos 10 dias habiles antes, el proveedor debe proporcionar el Estimado de Buena Fe al menos 3 dias habiles antes del servicio. Para citas programadas de 3 a 9 dias habiles antes, el estimado llega al menos 1 dia habil antes del servicio. La guia al consumidor federal y el portal de resolucion de disputas entre paciente y proveedor estan disponibles en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

paragraphs.en: To request a Good Faith Estimate for IVF at a North Dakota fertility clinic in 2026, follow these steps: (1) Contact the clinic's financial coordinator and identify yourself as self-pay or uninsured, or confirm that you want an itemized pre-treatment cost estimate even if you have insurance. (2) Request a written Good Faith Estimate listing the base cycle code (HCPCS S4015 for a fresh cycle, S4016 for a frozen cycle), anesthesia, laboratory fees, monitoring visit fees, and all optional add-ons such as ICSI, PGT, and embryo cryopreservation. (3) Provide your ZIP code and share the specific IVF protocol your reproductive endocrinologist has recommended, including the expected stimulation dose range. (4) Confirm the timing rule: if your egg retrieval is scheduled 10 or more business days out, you are entitled to the written estimate at least 3 business days before service; if scheduled 3 to 9 business days out, 1 business day before service. (5) Keep the written Good Faith Estimate. If your final North Dakota IVF bill exceeds the estimate by $400 or more, you have 120 days from the bill date to file a patient-provider dispute resolution (PPDR) claim at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.
paragraphs.es: Para solicitar un Estimado de Buena Fe para FIV en una clinica de fertilidad de Dakota del Norte en 2026, siga estos pasos: (1) Comuniquese con el coordinador financiero de la clinica e identifiquese como paciente de pago propio o sin seguro. (2) Solicite un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito que liste el codigo del ciclo base (HCPCS S4015 para ciclo fresco, S4016 para ciclo congelado), anestesia, honorarios de laboratorio, honorarios de visitas de monitoreo y todos los complementos opcionales como ICSI, PGT y criopreservacion de embriones. (3) Proporcione su codigo postal y comparta el protocolo especifico que su endocrinologo reproductivo ha recomendado. (4) Confirme el calendario: si su recuperacion esta programada 10 o mas dias habiles antes, tiene derecho al estimado al menos 3 dias habiles de antelacion; si esta programada de 3 a 9 dias habiles antes, 1 dia habil de antelacion. (5) Conserve el Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito. Si su factura final de FIV en Dakota del Norte supera el estimado en $400 o mas, tiene 120 dias desde la fecha de la factura para presentar una reclamacion PPDR en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

paragraphs.en: A Good Faith Estimate for North Dakota IVF is not a guaranteed final bill. Common reasons the actual charges exceed the estimate include: additional monitoring appointments required by your specific stimulation response, medication adjustments mid-cycle based on follicle development, unexpected embryo development outcomes requiring a different number of PGT biopsies, anesthesia billed by a separate provider not included in the clinic's base package, and storage fees for additional embryos beyond what the original estimate assumed. If the final North Dakota IVF bill exceeds the Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, the patient has 120 days from the bill date to file a PPDR claim at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.
paragraphs.es: Un Estimado de Buena Fe para la FIV en Dakota del Norte no es una factura final garantizada. Las razones comunes por las que los cargos reales superan el estimado incluyen: citas de monitoreo adicionales requeridas por su respuesta de estimulacion especifica, ajustes de medicamentos a mitad del ciclo, resultados inesperados del desarrollo embrionario, anestesia facturada por un proveedor separado no incluido en el paquete base de la clinica, y tarifas de almacenamiento para embriones adicionales mas alla de lo que el estimado original asumio. Si la factura final de FIV en Dakota del Norte supera el Estimado de Buena Fe en $400 o mas, el paciente tiene 120 dias desde la fecha de la factura para presentar una reclamacion PPDR en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

paragraphs.en: Commercial insurance coverage for IVF in North Dakota depends entirely on the employer's voluntary benefit decisions, since the state has no mandate. If your employer is fully insured under a North Dakota state-regulated plan, the plan is free to exclude IVF and most do. If your employer is self-insured (which is common at larger North Dakota employers and common in agriculture-adjacent industries), federal ERISA governs the plan and no state mandate applies even if one were enacted in the future. ACA-compliant plans purchased on the federal marketplace at healthcare.gov do not include IVF as an essential health benefit. Patients who believe they may have employer fertility coverage should review their Summary Plan Description, call the member services number on their insurance card, and ask explicitly whether IVF at Sanford Reproductive Medicine in Fargo is covered and in-network before beginning treatment.
paragraphs.es: La cobertura de seguro comercial para la FIV en Dakota del Norte depende completamente de las decisiones voluntarias de beneficios del empleador, ya que el estado no tiene mandato. Si su empleador esta totalmente asegurado bajo un plan regulado por el estado de Dakota del Norte, el plan es libre de excluir la FIV y la mayoria lo hace. Si su empleador es autoasegurado, rige el ERISA federal y no aplica ningun mandato estatal. Los planes ACA-compliant comprados en el mercado federal en healthcare.gov no incluyen la FIV como beneficio esencial de salud. Los pacientes que creen que pueden tener cobertura de fertilidad del empleador deben revisar su Descripcion del Plan Resumido y preguntar explicitamente si la FIV en Sanford Reproductive Medicine en Fargo esta cubierta y dentro de la red antes de comenzar el tratamiento.

items.en: No North Dakota insurance mandate: because the state has no law requiring commercial insurers to cover IVF, almost all North Dakota IVF patients pay out of pocket. Employer plans may voluntarily include fertility benefits but are not required to. Always confirm coverage in writing before starting treatment.
items.es: Sin mandato de seguro en Dakota del Norte: como el estado no tiene ley que exija que los aseguradores comerciales cubran la FIV, casi todos los pacientes de FIV en Dakota del Norte pagan de su bolsillo. Los planes de empleadores pueden incluir voluntariamente beneficios de fertilidad pero no estan obligados a hacerlo. Confirme siempre la cobertura por escrito antes de comenzar el tratamiento.

items.en: Clinic selection in North Dakota: Sanford Reproductive Medicine in Fargo (hospital-affiliated) is the primary in-state option and bills at a premium reflecting full hospital overhead. Some North Dakota patients travel to Minneapolis-Saint Paul area clinics or to lower-cost national providers to reduce per-cycle cost by $3,000 to $8,000.
items.es: Seleccion de clinica en Dakota del Norte: Sanford Reproductive Medicine en Fargo (afiliada a hospital) es la principal opcion en el estado y factura a una tarifa que refleja los gastos generales totales del hospital. Algunos pacientes de Dakota del Norte viajan a clinicas del area metropolitana de Minneapolis-Saint Paul o a proveedores nacionales de menor costo para reducir el costo por ciclo en $3,000 a $8,000.

items.en: Medication protocol and stimulation response: fertility medications billed separately add $2,000 to $7,000 per cycle. Poor responders may need higher doses or multiple retrieval attempts. Each cycle resets the medication cost.
items.es: Protocolo de medicacion y respuesta de estimulacion: los medicamentos de fertilidad facturados por separado agregan $2,000 a $7,000 por ciclo. Las personas con baja respuesta pueden necesitar dosis mas altas o multiples intentos de recuperacion. Cada ciclo reinicia el costo de medicamentos.

items.en: Number of IVF cycles required: success rates per cycle vary by age and diagnosis. Many North Dakota patients need 2 to 3 cycles to achieve pregnancy, potentially multiplying total out-of-pocket costs to $30,000 to $60,000 or more over the course of treatment.
items.es: Numero de ciclos de FIV requeridos: las tasas de exito por ciclo varian segun la edad y el diagnostico. Muchos pacientes de Dakota del Norte necesitan de 2 a 3 ciclos para lograr el embarazo, lo que puede multiplicar los costos totales de bolsillo a $30,000 a $60,000 o mas.

items.en: Independent clinic cash bundles and chargemaster discount asks: fertility clinics, like hospitals, maintain a published chargemaster rate. Self-pay patients who identify themselves before treatment begins and commit to prompt payment can often negotiate 10 to 20 percent off the base cycle fee. Ask the financial coordinator: 'What is your self-pay cash price, and is there a same-day or upfront-payment discount?'
items.es: Paquetes en efectivo de clinicas independientes y solicitudes de descuento en el arancel: las clinicas de fertilidad, como los hospitales, mantienen una tarifa de arancel publicada. Los pacientes que pagan de su bolsillo y se identifican antes de comenzar el tratamiento y se comprometen a un pago rapido a menudo pueden negociar un 10 a 20 por ciento de descuento en la tarifa del ciclo base.

items.en: ARC Fertility multi-cycle packages at Sanford: Sanford Reproductive Medicine partners with ARC Fertility to offer bundled multi-cycle package pricing and refund programs. These packages are typically 15 to 25 percent less expensive per cycle than paying cycle by cycle and include financing options for qualifying patients.
items.es: Paquetes de multiples ciclos ARC Fertility en Sanford: Sanford Reproductive Medicine se asocia con ARC Fertility para ofrecer precios de paquetes de multiples ciclos agrupados y programas de reembolso. Estos paquetes suelen ser un 15 a 25 por ciento menos costosos por ciclo que pagar ciclo por ciclo.

items.en: Sliding-scale FQHC and fertility grant programs: Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) in North Dakota do not typically perform IVF, but fertility grants through RESOLVE: The National Infertility Association and Baby Quest Foundation can reduce out-of-pocket costs by $2,000 to $15,000 for qualifying patients regardless of state. Income eligibility thresholds vary by grant program.
items.es: Programas de FQHC con escala movil y subvenciones de fertilidad: los Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente (FQHC) en Dakota del Norte tipicamente no realizan FIV, pero las subvenciones de fertilidad a traves de RESOLVE: The National Infertility Association y Baby Quest Foundation pueden reducir los costos de bolsillo en $2,000 a $15,000 para pacientes calificados.

items.en: Add-on costs such as PGT genetic testing ($3,000 to $6,000), ICSI ($1,000 to $2,000), donor eggs ($20,000 to $35,000 above the base cycle cost), and annual embryo storage ($500 to $1,000 per year) can substantially increase the total North Dakota IVF cost. Each add-on should appear as a separately itemized line on the Good Faith Estimate.
items.es: Los costos de complementos como las pruebas geneticas PGT ($3,000 a $6,000), ICSI ($1,000 a $2,000), ovulos de donante ($20,000 a $35,000 sobre el costo del ciclo base) y el almacenamiento anual de embriones ($500 a $1,000 por ano) pueden aumentar sustancialmente el costo total de FIV en Dakota del Norte. Cada complemento debe aparecer como una linea separada en el Estimado de Buena Fe.

intro.en: IVF billing in North Dakota is highly itemized and easy to overlook errors, especially when a cycle involves multiple components billed by different providers. Because North Dakota has no state mandate and most patients are self-pay, verifying every charge is critical. Check for these common billing errors before paying any IVF invoice:
intro.es: La facturacion de FIV en Dakota del Norte es muy detallada y es facil pasar por alto errores, especialmente cuando un ciclo involucra multiples componentes facturados por diferentes proveedores. Debido a que Dakota del Norte no tiene mandato estatal y la mayoria de los pacientes pagan de su bolsillo, verificar cada cargo es fundamental. Verifique estos errores de facturacion comunes antes de pagar cualquier factura de FIV:

items.en: ICSI billed on all eggs retrieved when it was only performed on a subset of eggs. Review your embryology lab report and count the number of eggs where ICSI was actually applied before approving the ICSI invoice.
items.es: ICSI facturado en todos los ovulos recuperados cuando solo se realizo en un subconjunto de ovulos. Revise su informe del laboratorio de embriologia y cuente el numero de ovulos donde se aplico realmente el ICSI antes de aprobar la factura de ICSI.

items.en: PGT biopsy fee charged for embryos that were arrested before Day 5 and never underwent biopsy. Request a cycle summary report from the embryology lab before paying any PGT invoice. You should only pay for biopsies that were actually performed.
items.es: Tarifa de biopsia PGT cobrada por embriones que se detuvieron antes del Dia 5 y nunca fueron biopsiados. Solicite un informe de resumen del ciclo del laboratorio de embriologia antes de pagar cualquier factura de PGT. Solo debe pagar por las biopsias que realmente se realizaron.

items.en: Anesthesia billed by a separate out-of-network provider not included in the base cycle package. Under the No Surprises Act, this may constitute a surprise bill. Confirm the anesthesia provider's network status before the egg retrieval procedure.
items.es: Anestesia facturada por un proveedor separado fuera de la red no incluido en el paquete del ciclo base. Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, esto puede constituir una factura sorpresa. Confirme el estado de la red del proveedor de anestesia antes del procedimiento de recuperacion de ovulos.

items.en: Frozen embryo transfer billed at the full fresh IVF cycle rate instead of the lower FET rate quoted and agreed upon in the original Good Faith Estimate. Compare the FET line item on the final bill to the FET line item on your written Good Faith Estimate.
items.es: Transferencia de embrion congelado facturada a la tarifa de ciclo de FIV fresco completo en lugar de la tarifa de TEC mas baja cotizada y acordada en el Estimado de Buena Fe original. Compare el elemento de TEC en la factura final con el elemento de TEC en su Estimado de Buena Fe escrito.

items.en: Medications billed at retail pharmacy prices when a specialty pharmacy discount or clinic-dispensed price was available at lower cost. Ask the North Dakota clinic whether they can dispense medications directly or refer to a specialty pharmacy with contracted lower rates.
items.es: Medicamentos facturados a precios de farmacia minorista cuando habia disponible un descuento de farmacia especializada o un precio dispensado por la clinica a menor costo. Pregunte a la clinica de Dakota del Norte si pueden dispensar medicamentos directamente o referir a una farmacia especializada con tarifas contractuales mas bajas.

items.en: Cycle cancellation fees charged under HCPCS S4017 (incomplete cycle, cancelled before stimulation) when the cycle was not cancelled before stimulation began. Verify the stage at which the cycle was cancelled against the specific code and fee being charged.
items.es: Cargos de cancelacion de ciclo cobrados bajo HCPCS S4017 (ciclo incompleto, cancelado antes de la estimulacion) cuando el ciclo no fue cancelado antes de que comenzara la estimulacion. Verifique la etapa en que se cancelo el ciclo contra el codigo y tarifa especificos que se estan cobrando.

en.question: How much does IVF cost in North Dakota without insurance in 2026?
en.answer: A standard IVF cycle in North Dakota costs $12,000 to $17,000 for the base procedure in 2026 at most clinics, with Sanford Reproductive Medicine in Fargo (the primary hospital-affiliated option) reporting patient all-in costs of approximately $20,000 to $21,000 including medications and monitoring. Adding fertility medications ($2,000 to $7,000) brings the realistic out-of-pocket total to $15,000 to $25,000 per cycle. Optional add-ons such as PGT genetic testing ($3,000 to $6,000) and ICSI ($1,000 to $2,000) add to the total. Patients who need 2 to 3 cycles may spend $30,000 to $60,000 or more over the course of treatment.

en.question: Does Medicare cover IVF in North Dakota?
en.answer: No. Medicare does not cover IVF under Original Medicare Part A, Medicare Part B, or Part D, regardless of state. This is a federal program-level exclusion that applies equally in North Dakota. The 2026 Medicare Part B deductible of $283 and the standard 20% coinsurance apply only to covered services; because IVF is excluded, no Medicare deductible or coinsurance calculation applies to IVF costs. A small number of Medicare Advantage plans offer supplemental fertility-related benefits voluntarily, but coverage of IVF itself is not required and is rare. Medigap supplements also do not cover IVF because they only wrap around services Original Medicare already covers.

en.question: How do I request a Good Faith Estimate for IVF at a North Dakota fertility clinic?
en.answer: Under the No Surprises Act (effective January 2022), every North Dakota fertility clinic must provide a written Good Faith Estimate to self-pay and uninsured patients before treatment. Call the clinic's financial coordinator and identify yourself as self-pay or uninsured. Request an itemized written estimate listing the base cycle code (HCPCS S4015 for fresh, S4016 for frozen), anesthesia, laboratory fees, monitoring visit fees, and any agreed add-ons such as ICSI, PGT, and embryo storage. For a retrieval scheduled 10 or more business days out, you are entitled to the estimate at least 3 business days before service. Keep the written estimate. If your final bill exceeds it by $400 or more, you have 120 days to file a dispute at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

en.question: What is the No Surprises Act and does it apply to IVF in North Dakota?
en.answer: The No Surprises Act, effective January 1, 2022, is a federal law that protects self-pay and uninsured patients from unexpected medical bills. It applies to all healthcare providers and facilities in North Dakota, including fertility clinics, hospital reproductive medicine departments such as Sanford Reproductive Medicine in Fargo, and independent labs. Any patient who is uninsured or paying cash for IVF in North Dakota has the right to a written Good Faith Estimate of expected charges before treatment. If the actual bill exceeds the Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, the patient can file a patient-provider dispute resolution (PPDR) claim within 120 days through the federal portal at cms.gov/nosurprisesact. The law does not cap IVF prices, but it creates an enforceable pre-treatment pricing commitment.

en.question: How do I get a written cash-pay quote for IVF in North Dakota?
en.answer: Contact the financial coordinator at Sanford Reproductive Medicine in Fargo (the primary North Dakota clinic) and ask for their self-pay or fee-for-service IVF price list. Request the base fresh cycle fee, the frozen embryo transfer fee, and any fees billed separately such as anesthesia, lab fees, monitoring visits, and medications. Ask whether the clinic offers a cash-pay discount for prompt payment (typically 10 to 20 percent off the listed rate). Ask about ARC Fertility multi-cycle package pricing, which can reduce the per-cycle cost by 15 to 25 percent. Get all quotes in writing as a Good Faith Estimate under the No Surprises Act before scheduling any procedure. If the North Dakota quote is substantially higher than neighboring state clinics, compare costs at Minneapolis-area fertility centers, since some North Dakota patients travel for lower per-cycle fees.

en.question: Can I negotiate an IVF bill after the fact in North Dakota?
en.answer: Yes. If your final bill exceeds your original Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, you can file a federal patient-provider dispute resolution (PPDR) claim within 120 days of the bill date at cms.gov/nosurprisesact. Outside the formal PPDR process, North Dakota fertility clinics and billing departments will often negotiate a reduced cash-pay settlement if you offer to pay promptly. Typical reductions for cash-pay-now offers run 20 to 35 percent off the remaining balance. Ask the billing office to provide a fully itemized statement and identify any line items you believe were added in error, such as ICSI applied to all eggs when only a subset was injected, or PGT fees for embryos that arrested before biopsy. Billing errors of this type are common and worth challenging before paying.

en.question: What is the difference between hospital-affiliated and independent IVF clinic costs in North Dakota?
en.answer: Hospital-affiliated clinics such as Sanford Reproductive Medicine in Fargo bill IVF at a premium that includes full hospital overhead, staffing levels, and integrated care infrastructure. Patient-reported all-in costs at Sanford run $20,000 to $21,000 per fresh cycle including medications. Independent fertility clinics and national lower-cost providers serving the North Dakota market typically charge $12,000 to $17,000 for the base procedure. The clinical procedure, egg retrieval, fertilization, and embryo transfer, is identical between settings. For most patients, the main practical difference is cost, convenience of location in North Dakota, and whether the clinic's ARC Fertility partnership provides financing or package pricing that offsets the base cost premium.

en.question: Does North Dakota require health insurance to cover IVF?
en.answer: No. North Dakota has no state law requiring commercial insurance plans to cover IVF as of 2026. House Bill 1282, which would have expanded PERS public employee fertility coverage, was defeated 36 to 51 in the North Dakota House in February 2025. House Bill 1284, which would have required commercial plans to cover four cycles of cryopreservation, was defeated 39 to 48 in the same session. North Dakota Medicaid does not cover IVF. ACA-compliant plans on the federal marketplace at healthcare.gov do not include IVF as a required essential health benefit. Some employers voluntarily offer fertility benefits; check your Summary Plan Description. If you work for a North Dakota employer and your plan is fully insured (not self-funded), confirm with your employer whether any fertility benefit has been voluntarily added.

en.question: What is the difference between IVF and IUI, and is either covered in North Dakota?
en.answer: IUI (intrauterine insemination) is a less invasive fertility procedure that places prepared sperm directly into the uterus during ovulation. IUI typically costs $300 to $1,500 per cycle and does not require egg retrieval or an external fertilization laboratory. IVF involves stimulating multiple eggs, retrieving them surgically, fertilizing them in a lab, and transferring the resulting embryo. IVF success rates per cycle are generally higher than IUI, but IVF costs 10 to 20 times more. Neither IUI nor IVF is required to be covered by North Dakota commercial insurance as of 2026. Essentia Health in West Fargo offers IUI for infertility evaluations; patients needing IVF are typically referred to Sanford Reproductive Medicine in Fargo. North Dakota Medicaid does not cover IUI or IVF as fertility treatments.

en.question: What are the HCPCS billing codes for IVF in North Dakota?
en.answer: The primary public-domain HCPCS Level II codes used for IVF billing are: S4015 (complete IVF cycle, not otherwise specified, case rate) for fresh cycles; S4016 (frozen IVF cycle, case rate) for frozen embryo transfers; and S4017 (incomplete cycle, cancelled before stimulation, case rate). These codes are public domain and used by commercial insurers in North Dakota and nationally. Medicare excludes IVF and does not process claims under these codes. North Dakota Medicaid similarly does not cover IVF-related claims. Always ask your North Dakota fertility clinic to include itemized billing codes in the Good Faith Estimate so you can verify that charges on the final bill match services actually rendered.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta la FIV en Dakota del Norte sin seguro en 2026?
es.answer: Un ciclo estandar de FIV en Dakota del Norte cuesta de $12,000 a $17,000 por el procedimiento base en 2026 en la mayoria de las clinicas, con Sanford Reproductive Medicine en Fargo (la principal opcion afiliada a hospital) reportando costos totales de pacientes de aproximadamente $20,000 a $21,000 incluyendo medicamentos y monitoreo. Agregar medicamentos de fertilidad ($2,000 a $7,000) lleva el total realista de bolsillo a $15,000 a $25,000 por ciclo. Los complementos opcionales como las pruebas geneticas PGT ($3,000 a $6,000) y el ICSI ($1,000 a $2,000) agregan al total. Los pacientes que necesitan 2 a 3 ciclos pueden gastar $30,000 a $60,000 o mas durante el curso del tratamiento.

es.question: Cubre Medicare la FIV en Dakota del Norte?
es.answer: No. Medicare no cubre la FIV bajo el Medicare Original Parte A, Medicare Parte B o Parte D, independientemente del estado. Esta es una exclusion a nivel de programa federal que aplica igualmente en Dakota del Norte. El deducible de Medicare Parte B 2026 de $283 y el coseguro estandar del 20% solo aplican a los servicios cubiertos; como la FIV esta excluida, no aplica ningun calculo de deducible o coseguro de Medicare para los costos de FIV. Un pequeno numero de planes Medicare Advantage ofrecen beneficios suplementarios relacionados con la fertilidad de forma voluntaria, pero la cobertura de la FIV en si no es obligatoria y es poco comun. Los suplementos Medigap tampoco cubren la FIV.

es.question: Como solicito un Estimado de Buena Fe para FIV en una clinica de fertilidad de Dakota del Norte?
es.answer: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas (vigente desde enero de 2022), cada clinica de fertilidad de Dakota del Norte debe proporcionar un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito a los pacientes que pagan de su bolsillo o no tienen seguro antes del tratamiento. Llame al coordinador financiero de la clinica e identifiquese como paciente de pago propio o sin seguro. Solicite un estimado escrito detallado que liste el codigo del ciclo base (HCPCS S4015 para fresco, S4016 para congelado), anestesia, honorarios de laboratorio, honorarios de visitas de monitoreo y todos los complementos acordados como ICSI, PGT y almacenamiento de embriones. Conserve el estimado escrito. Si su factura final lo supera en $400 o mas, tiene 120 dias para presentar una disputa en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

es.question: Que es la Ley de No Sorpresas y aplica a la FIV en Dakota del Norte?
es.answer: La Ley de No Sorpresas, vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2022, es una ley federal que protege a los pacientes que pagan de su bolsillo o no tienen seguro de facturas medicas inesperadas. Aplica a todos los proveedores de atencion medica e instalaciones en Dakota del Norte, incluyendo las clinicas de fertilidad, los departamentos de medicina reproductiva de hospitales como Sanford Reproductive Medicine en Fargo, y los laboratorios independientes. Cualquier paciente que no tenga seguro o pague en efectivo por la FIV en Dakota del Norte tiene derecho a un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito de los cargos esperados antes del tratamiento. Si la factura real supera el Estimado de Buena Fe en $400 o mas, el paciente puede presentar una reclamacion PPDR dentro de 120 dias a traves del portal federal en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

es.question: Como obtengo una cotizacion de pago en efectivo por escrito para FIV en Dakota del Norte?
es.answer: Comuniquese con el coordinador financiero de Sanford Reproductive Medicine en Fargo y solicite su lista de precios de FIV de pago propio. Solicite la tarifa del ciclo fresco base, la tarifa de transferencia de embrion congelado y cualquier tarifa facturada por separado como anestesia, honorarios de laboratorio, visitas de monitoreo y medicamentos. Pregunte si la clinica ofrece un descuento de pago en efectivo por pago puntual (tipicamente del 10 al 20 por ciento de la tarifa indicada). Pregunte sobre los precios de paquetes de multiples ciclos ARC Fertility, que pueden reducir el costo por ciclo en un 15 a 25 por ciento. Obtenga todas las cotizaciones por escrito como Estimado de Buena Fe bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas antes de programar cualquier procedimiento.

es.question: Puedo negociar una factura de FIV despues del hecho en Dakota del Norte?
es.answer: Si. Si su factura final supera su Estimado de Buena Fe original en $400 o mas, puede presentar una reclamacion federal de resolucion de disputas entre paciente y proveedor (PPDR) dentro de los 120 dias de la fecha de la factura en cms.gov/nosurprisesact. Fuera del proceso PPDR formal, las clinicas de fertilidad y departamentos de facturacion de Dakota del Norte a menudo negociaran un acuerdo de pago en efectivo reducido si usted ofrece pagar con prontitud. Las reducciones tipicas para las ofertas de pago en efectivo inmediato son del 20 al 35 por ciento del saldo restante. Solicite al departamento de facturacion un estado completamente detallado e identifique cualquier elemento que crea que fue agregado por error.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre los costos de clinicas de FIV afiliadas a hospitales e independientes en Dakota del Norte?
es.answer: Las clinicas afiliadas a hospitales como Sanford Reproductive Medicine en Fargo facturan la FIV a una tarifa que incluye los gastos generales totales del hospital. Los costos totales reportados por pacientes en Sanford son de $20,000 a $21,000 por ciclo fresco incluyendo medicamentos. Las clinicas de fertilidad independientes y los proveedores nacionales de menor costo que atienden al mercado de Dakota del Norte tipicamente cobran de $12,000 a $17,000 por el procedimiento base. El procedimiento clinico, la recuperacion de ovulos, la fertilizacion y la transferencia de embriones, es identico entre los entornos. Para la mayoria de los pacientes, la principal diferencia practica es el costo y la conveniencia de ubicacion en Dakota del Norte.

es.question: Exige Dakota del Norte que el seguro medico cubra la FIV?
es.answer: No. Dakota del Norte no tiene ley estatal que exija que los planes de seguro comercial cubran la FIV a partir de 2026. La Factura de la Camara 1282, que habria ampliado la cobertura de fertilidad para empleados publicos de PERS, fue derrotada 36 a 51 en la Camara de Dakota del Norte en febrero de 2025. La Factura de la Camara 1284, que habria exigido que los planes comerciales cubrieran cuatro ciclos de criopreservacion, fue derrotada 39 a 48 en la misma sesion. El Medicaid de Dakota del Norte no cubre la FIV. Los planes ACA-compliant en el mercado federal en healthcare.gov no incluyen la FIV como beneficio esencial de salud requerido. Algunos empleadores ofrecen voluntariamente beneficios de fertilidad; revise su Descripcion del Plan Resumido.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre la FIV y la IIU, y cubre alguna de las dos en Dakota del Norte?
es.answer: La IIU (inseminacion intrauterina) es un procedimiento de fertilidad menos invasivo que coloca esperma preparado directamente en el utero durante la ovulacion. La IIU tipicamente cuesta de $300 a $1,500 por ciclo y no requiere recuperacion de ovulos ni un laboratorio de fertilizacion externo. La FIV implica estimular multiples ovulos, recuperarlos quirurgicamente, fertilizarlos en un laboratorio y transferir el embrion resultante. Ninguna de las dos (IIU o FIV) es requerida para ser cubierta por el seguro comercial de Dakota del Norte a partir de 2026. Essentia Health en West Fargo ofrece IIU; los pacientes que necesitan FIV generalmente son referidos a Sanford Reproductive Medicine en Fargo. El Medicaid de Dakota del Norte no cubre la IIU ni la FIV como tratamientos de fertilidad.

es.question: Cuales son los codigos de facturacion HCPCS para la FIV en Dakota del Norte?
es.answer: Los principales codigos HCPCS Nivel II de dominio publico utilizados para la facturacion de FIV son: S4015 (ciclo completo de FIV, tarifa por caso) para ciclos frescos; S4016 (ciclo de FIV congelado, tarifa por caso) para transferencias de embriones congelados; y S4017 (ciclo incompleto, cancelado antes de la estimulacion, tarifa por caso). Estos codigos son de dominio publico y son utilizados por aseguradores comerciales en Dakota del Norte y a nivel nacional. Medicare excluye la FIV y no procesa reclamaciones bajo estos codigos. El Medicaid de Dakota del Norte tampoco cubre los reclamos relacionados con la FIV. Siempre solicite a su clinica de fertilidad de Dakota del Norte que incluya los codigos de facturacion detallados en el Estimado de Buena Fe.

ARC Fertility multi-cycle package pricing and refund programs (available through Sanford)
Lower-cost national fertility clinics serving North Dakota patients (including travel to Minneapolis-area clinics)
Fertility grant programs through RESOLVE: The National Infertility Association and Baby Quest Foundation
Specialty pharmacy discount programs for fertility medications
Financing through clinic partners such as ARC Fertility and CapexMD
selfPayPrograms.typicalDiscountRange: 10 to 20 percent below published chargemaster cash price for self-pay prompt-payment negotiations; 15 to 25 percent per-cycle savings through ARC Fertility multi-cycle packages
howToAsk: Call before scheduling and ask: 'What is your self-pay or fee-for-service IVF price for a fresh cycle, and is there a cash-payment discount for paying upfront?'
Get the complete itemized price in writing as a Good Faith Estimate before signing any financial agreement or beginning treatment
Ask specifically whether anesthesia, lab fees, monitoring visits, and medications are included in the base cycle price or billed separately
Ask about ARC Fertility multi-cycle or shared-risk package pricing: these are typically 15 to 25 percent less expensive per cycle than paying cycle by cycle
Compare North Dakota clinic self-pay rates to Minneapolis-area fertility clinics, since some patients save $3,000 to $8,000 per cycle by traveling to Minnesota
Ask about same-day or upfront-payment discounts: some North Dakota-area clinics offer 5 to 15 percent off for prompt cash payment at time of service
